summary: ASTROTECH Corp filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) to register an at-the-market offering of up to $24.5 million of common stock through H.C. Wainwright as sales agent. The shares will be sold into the Nasdaq Capital Market at prevailing market prices; no fixed price, premium, or specific terms are set. The agent receives a 3.0% commission. The filing is a routine capital-raising shelf takedown under Rule 415, not a special situation event. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other transformative event. The filing does not trigger any special-situations classification; it is an ordinary equity distribution.
